# LashiraBloom — Full Map Element Inventory

Status: **living reference document, auto-synced, no build required to read it.** Created 2026-07-10.

This is the ground-truth inventory of **every placed element** across the Kingdom map and the 5 realm maps — buildings, zones, props, harvest nodes, hotspots, portals. Companion to `CONCEPT-portal-markers-and-openworld-builder.md` (this doc is the data that Builder would load).

**How this stays a 1:1 mirror:** §1 (Kingdom map) is not hand-typed — it is generated by `apps/lashira/web/scripts/gen-map-inventory.mjs`, which reads the real source files (`farm-map.js`, `world-map-registry.js`, `realms/*.js`) and regenerates the block between the `<!-- AUTO:KINGDOM:START/END -->` markers below. **Never hand-edit inside those markers** — run the sync script instead (see §4). §2 (the 5 realm maps' *visual* art content) still requires a human to open each PNG and compare it to the code — that part stays manually maintained and is reviewed each session it's touched.

Confidence key: 🟢 pixel/code-verified · 🟡 visually plausible, not tile-calibrated · 🔴 placeholder/guess, contradicted or unconfirmed by the real art.

### 1.10 Corrections from manual review (hand-maintained — these are judgment calls, not extractable facts)

- **My earlier "domed silver estate = Lashira Keep" guess was wrong.** That structure (top-right, silver dome, gated pens) is the **Barn/Coop/Pens cluster** — it matches `BUILDINGS.barn`/`BUILDINGS.coop` + `PENS.*` exactly (§1.2/§1.1 above). Withdrawn. The castle-centered `lashira_keep` portal placement already in the code (§1.6) is correct and should stand.
- **Hearthrush Kitchen's portal isn't floating in nowhere** — it sits immediately left of the Market building (`BUILDINGS.shop` at 30,16) — but there is still **no kitchen-specific sprite** (counter, hearth, signage) on the Kingdom basemap. Recommend generating one small addition, or accept the Market as the kitchen's shared front door.
- **Minor sprite/hotspot drift, not a bug:** the General Store's `ONTOP` sprite anchor (13,19) sits one tile above its hotspot tap-rect (13,20–15,22). Cosmetic drift only — noted so it isn't mistaken for a coordinate error later.
- **3 shop icons (General/Animal/Cosmetics) + the Dungeon Gate are visually present but not wired** (`ported:false` — §1.5). Pre-existing scaffolding, not introduced by the openworld work.

### 1.11 Dynamic / non-fixed elements (explicitly NOT part of the static inventory — a script can't extract these because they have no fixed coordinates)
- **Arena monsters** — spawn procedurally inside `ARENA`/`BATTLEGROUND`, up to `SPAWN_TUNING.maxConcurrent` (default 5).
- **Crops** — planted per-plot inside `FIELD` by players; state-driven, not placed.
- **Animals** (cow/sheep/chicken sprites) — roam within their pen rect.
- **Peers / other players** — realtime presence.
- **Lily pads / grass-tuft decoration** — procedurally scattered by a seeded hash, regenerates identically every load but isn't hand-placed.

## 2. The 5 realm maps — real art vs. current code assumptions (hand-maintained — requires opening each PNG)

None of these are pixel-calibrated yet (unlike the Kingdom map above). I opened each PNG and compared it against what `apps/lashira/web/src/game/realms/*.js` currently assumes. **The "code coords" column below should match §1.9 (auto-generated) — if it doesn't, §1.9 is the one that's current; update this section's prose.**

### 2.1 Hearthrush Kitchen (`hearthrush-kitchen.png`)
Real art layout: **pantry/ingredients along the entire left wall** (barrels, sacks, crates), **stove/oven row top-center** (pots already boiling), **two prep tables** in the middle of the room, and a **serving hall + dining tables far right** (banners, a service counter, rugs). It's a wide room, not a single row.

| Station (code, `STATIONS` in `kitchen.jsx`, see §1.9) | Matches real art? |
|---|---|
| Pantry | 🔴 Real pantry is the **entire left third** of the image, not a single mid-map pad |
| Stove | 🔴 Real stove row is **top-center**, not mid-map at the same row as pantry/serve |
| Serve/window | 🔴 Real serving hall is the **entire right third**, separated by a partition wall from the kitchen |

**Recommendation:** re-author station pads once this map gets pixel-calibrated in the Builder — a left→top→right flow (pantry → stove → serve) matching the real room, instead of three pads in a row.

### 2.2 Bloomwall Pass (`bloomwall-pass.png`)
Real art is unusually complete: a **winding dirt road** from upper-left forest to the **south gate/keep**, lower-right, with a **grid already baked into the art**. **~11 stone tower pads are already pre-drawn** along the path. A glowing **Bloom Core crystal** sits mid-path near the gate, and a **cave mouth** (boss/dungeon flavor) is up-right.

**Updated 2026-07-10 — this realm's code has since been substantially rewritten** (see §1.9, now auto-synced): it grew from a single 5-point path + 4 pads into a real **forking two-lane system** (`LEAD_IN` → splits into `BRANCH_A`/`BRANCH_B` → merges → `CORE`), **8 tower pads** (up from 4 — much closer to the art brief's "8-12 pads"), and real bestiary monsters (`ZONE_MOBS` meadow/grove/cavern progression, a Tiger boss every 10th wave, Endless mode after). This closes most of the earlier gap:

| Element (code, see §1.9) | Matches real art? |
|---|---|
| Lane geometry (now forking, not a single line) | 🟡 much more plausible shape now — still not tile-verified against the baked road, but a fork matches "winding path" far better than one straight line did |
| Tower pads (now 8, was 4) | 🟡 close to the real ~11 pre-drawn pedestals — improved, not yet exact |
| Core | 🟡 Real crystal sits mid-path, closer to the gate — roughly plausible, not verified |
| Cave/boss entrance | 🟡 **partially addressed in spirit** — a Tiger boss wave now exists (every 10th wave), though it's not tied to the art's specific cave-mouth location yet |
| Gate/keep entrance | 🔴 **Still not modeled as a location** — the real art's south gate is a strong "return to Kingdom" anchor point, still not used as a world-space element |

**Recommendation:** this realm improved the most since the last review — next step is tile-calibrating the lane/pads against the actual pre-drawn pedestals (still 8 modeled vs. ~11 drawn) rather than adding new mechanics.

### 2.3 Lashira Keep (`lashira-keep.png`)
Real art has **8 labeled districts with baked text signage**: FARM, MARKET, KITCHEN, ACADEMY, GARDEN, DEFENSE ×2, WORKSHOP, HOUSING — arranged in a 3-row grid around a central castle-courtyard building, with corner watchtowers and a south gate.

| Element (code, `DEFAULTS` in `keep.js`, see §1.9) | Matches real art? |
|---|---|
| Districts (3 in code: farm/market/workshop, one row) | 🔴 Real art has **8 districts in 3 rows**, not 3 in one row — undercounts significantly |
| District art (generic pad + icon) | 🔴 Real art has **named signage already baked in** per district — code doesn't use or match these labels |

**Important cross-reference:** the real Keep art has a **KITCHEN district sign already baked in**. This doesn't fix the Kingdom-map "no kitchen building" gap directly (Keep is a different realm), but it's a strong signal that "Kitchen" was already planned as a Keep district in whatever generated this art — worth reconciling: is Hearthrush Kitchen a standalone portal (current design) or should it route through Keep's Kitchen district? Flagging as an open question, not resolving it here.

**Also note:** this art violates the roadmap's own "no labels/text baked into basemaps" rule (`roadmap-and-build-plan.md §6/§7`) — it shipped with literal signage. Not a defect exactly (it reads well), but a deviation from the stated art guideline worth a conscious decision (keep the labels since they're clear and helpful, or regenerate without them for consistency with the rule).

**Recommendation:** re-author `keep.js` districts to match all 8 real districts once calibrated; decide the Kitchen-portal-vs-Kitchen-district question explicitly.

### 2.4 Fountain Festival (`fountain-festival.png`)
Real art: a central **fountain with a glowing portal ring** built into its base (left-of-center), festival stalls ringing it, and — importantly — a **distinct rectangular puzzle-board plaza already drawn** to the right of the fountain (a flat panel with faint rotation/footprint icons), plus floral arches lower-right and upper-right.

| Element (code, `festival.jsx`) | Matches real art? |
|---|---|
| Board anchor | 🟡 `festival.jsx` has **no fixed world-space coordinates at all** — the board is a DOM overlay (`movement:false`), not anchored to any map position. The real art has a specific, obvious spot for it (right of the fountain) that the code doesn't use. |
| Fountain/portal ring | 🟡 real fountain's built-in portal ring is thematically perfect for the "return" visual, currently unused |

**Recommendation:** anchor the board overlay to appear near the real puzzle-plaza panel (screen position echoing its world location) rather than dead-center, for continuity once the player can see the map behind it.

### 2.5 Emberring Arena (`emberring-arena.png`)
Real art: a clean circular arena, **glowing objective ring dead-center**, symmetric cover blocks/benches, torches + banners around the rim, two entrance paths (left and right) breaking through the tree line.

| Element (code, `arena.js`) | Matches real art? |
|---|---|
| Objective / spawn points | 🔴 **`arena.js` has no fixed coordinates at all** — training dummies spawn via `SPAWN() = [26+rand*14, 22+rand*12]`, a random range, not a fixed objective or spawn tile. *(Correction: an earlier pass of this doc stated fixed values 31,25 / 23,19 / 39,31 for this realm — those numbers came from the Builder mockup's placeholder data, not the real game code. Corrected here.)* |
| Cover blocks | 🔴 real art has **fixed symmetric cover** the loop doesn't use for tactical positioning |

**Recommendation:** the real art's dead-center glowing ring is a natural fixed objective anchor — worth giving `arena.js` an actual fixed objective/spawn constant (matching the art) instead of the current fully-random dummy placement, once calibrated.

| Kingdom (`basemap.png`) | 🟢 pixel-calibrated, ground truth, auto-synced | 3 shops + dungeon gate visually present but not wired (pre-existing) |
| Hearthrush Kitchen | 🔴 uncalibrated | Station layout (row-of-3) doesn't match the real room (left/top/right) |
| Bloomwall Pass | 🟡 partially plausible, improved | 8 of ~11 real tower pads modeled (was 4); lanes now fork realistically; gate location still unused |
| Lashira Keep | 🔴 uncalibrated | Only 3 of 8 real labeled districts modeled |
| Fountain Festival | 🟡 partially plausible | Board isn't anchored to the real puzzle-plaza panel; code has zero fixed coords |
| Emberring Arena | 🟡 partially plausible | No fixed coords in code at all (fully random spawns); real art's cover blocks unused |

This is exactly the gap the Openworld Builder (Part 2/3 of the companion concept doc) exists to close — every row above becomes a Builder session: open the tab, drag markers onto the real landmarks, paint collision, export the prompt, and the code catches up to the art.

## 4. Keeping this doc in sync

**§1 (Kingdom map) is machine-generated. Run this after touching any of these files:**
- `apps/lashira/web/src/game/farm-map.js` (zones, buildings, placements, hotspots, harvest nodes, castle, spawn)
- `apps/lashira/web/src/game/world-map-registry.js` (the 5 portals)
- `apps/lashira/web/src/game/realms/kitchen.jsx`, `bloomwall.js`, `keep.js` (station/pad/district coordinates)

```bash
cd apps/lashira/web
npm run map:sync
```

This regenerates everything between `<!-- AUTO:KINGDOM:START -->` and `<!-- AUTO:KINGDOM:END -->` in this file — table counts, coordinates, statuses — straight from the live source. It does not execute the game (no browser, no DOM); it extracts plain object/array literals from the source text and evaluates just those, so it's safe to run any time, including mid-refactor.

**§2 (the 5 realm maps' art content) cannot be auto-generated** — it requires a human to open each PNG and judge what's actually drawn. When a realm's art is regenerated/replaced, or its loop module's coordinates change, re-open the PNG, re-compare against the (now-fresh) §1.9 table, and update §2's prose by hand. The "Matches real art?" column is the part that always needs a human.

**Rule of thumb:** if you changed *numbers*, run the script. If you changed *art*, open the image and re-write the paragraph.
